description: This file defines a DeviceHandler class responsible for gathering and providing device-related information such as battery status, device info, permissions, and health metrics within an Android application. It includes methods for constructing JSON payloads with device data and handles various system services.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for handling device information and status reporting within an Android environment.

classes.name: BatterySnapshot
classes.description: Data class representing a snapshot of battery status including level, charging state, temperature.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with current device status such as battery, thermal, storage, and network info.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with device identification and system information.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions
methods.description: Provides a JSON string containing the current permission status for various device features.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth
methods.description: Returns health-related metrics of the device, including memory and battery health.

methods.name: statusPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs JSON payload with battery, thermal, storage, and network status.

methods.name: infoPayloadJson
methods.description: Builds JSON with device and system details such as model, manufacturer, and OS version.

methods.name: permissionsPayloadJson
methods.description: Creates JSON describing current permissions and capabilities.

methods.name: healthPayloadJson
methods.description: Generates JSON with device memory and battery health metrics.

methods.name: readBatterySnapshot
methods.description: Reads current battery information and returns a BatterySnapshot object.

methods.name: batteryLevelFraction
methods.description: Calculates battery level as a fraction from Intent extras.

methods.name: mapBatteryState
methods.description: Converts battery status code to human-readable string.

methods.name: mapChargingType
methods.description: Converts battery plug type code to string representation.

methods.name: mapThermalState
methods.description: Maps thermal status code to a string indicating device thermal condition.

methods.name: mapNetworkStatus
methods.description: Maps network capabilities to a string describing network satisfaction level.

methods.name: permissionStateJson
methods.description: Helper to create JSON object for permission state with granted status and promptability.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the application has a specific permission.

methods.name: mapMemoryPressure
methods.description: Determines memory pressure level based on total and available memory.

methods.name: networkInterfacesJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON array of network interface types based on capabilities.
